name: I SCREAM
source:
"Don't worry, I'll protect you!"

Now that you ran away from your abusive mother, someone special is offering you to join their club ! You agree, it wouldn't hurt to try it out, plus you have nowhere else to go...

[From [url=https://sacchariinee.itch.io/i-scream]itch.io[/url]]
